turns.input: Jessa Rook gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration:
Jessa Rook hefts the pair of leather boots from where she'd been carrying them, examining Nicco's feet with a glance before extending them toward him. "You'll ruin good parchment slippers on streets like these," she says. Her voice stays low, unhurried. "These were left behind by someone who failed to settle a tab. Cleaned, soles checked. Better than nothing."

She offers them without ceremony, her scarred eyebrow neither raised nor furrowed, simply watching to see whether he'll take them.

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
Jessa Rook watches him with the steady, unhurried patience of someone used to guests who talked themselves in circles. She does not reach for the boots.

"Left means unclaimed," she says, her low voice level. "Not mine to need. I keep a storeroom of such things—someone always arrives with less than they thought. You're standing outside a tower you'll need to walk around, if the square's any hint of the approach." She glances at his feet, then back to his face. "Take them or don't. I'm not counting favors."
